Hymn 33: Our Mountain Home So Dear
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: Emmeline B. Wells
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 33 titled "Our Mountain Home So Dear" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Emmeline B. Wells.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
